scope: A checked history, not a live cloud dashboard. A missing result is never counted as a model failure. Different models, judges, agent programs and attempt budgets are not directly comparable.

metric_standard.pass_at_1: Share of known weaknesses found in one designated attempt
metric_standard.pass_at_3_avg: Average success rate across three independent attempts
metric_standard.pass_at_3_max: Share of known weaknesses found at least once across three independent attempts
metric_standard.missing_value: Not available means the saved evidence cannot support that metric; it never means zero

paper_reference.title: AgentCyberRange: Benchmarking Frontier AI Systems in Realistic Cyber Ranges
paper_reference.note: Published reference results. Each model used the agent program named in its row, so these are context rather than matched controls for Fleet's OpenCode evaluations.

runs.name: Fresh75 checkpoint · complete GPT-scored evaluation
runs.scoring: 15 saved attempts scored; all result bundles independently verified
runs.note: This is a complete pass@1 result: one attempt on each website. Three attempts earned a non-zero score. It is not yet evidence of improvement because the older base-model result used four attempts per website and a different run. A matched base-model control is still needed.

config.Scoring during collection: Disabled; saved attempts were scored later

runs.name: Fresh75 checkpoint · provisional Pass@3 result
runs.collection: 104 usable attempts across 13 of 15 websites; 16 attempts are still being recovered
runs.scoring: 104 saved attempts scored; all 13 result bundles independently verified; no scoring failures
runs.note: This is a provisional result, not the full benchmark. It covers 100 of 110 known weaknesses on 13 websites. For each weakness, we calculated every possible three-attempt group among the eight saved attempts, so no favorable group was hand-picked. The result will be recalculated when the remaining 16 attempts arrive.

config.Scoring during collection: Disabled; saved attempts were scored later
config.Pass@3 calculation: Average across every possible group of three from each website's eight attempts

runs.name: Qwen3.8 baseline · GPT rescore
runs.note: A usable partial result, not a complete baseline. Eight attempts had unavailable websites, four had model-authentication failures, and four had agent-process failures. Only seven websites have all four usable attempts. The same saved work was scored again; the model did not retry the tasks.

config.Conversation shortening: Automatic; 20,000 reserved tokens; did not activate in these attempts
config.Judge temperature: Not sent; unsupported by this model
config.Evidence check: 44 result hashes and 243 original report/automatic-check files verified; 199 complete judge responses

runs.name: Qwen3.8 baseline · original failed scoring
runs.judge: GLM-5.3, unavailable under the configured name
runs.scoring: Original judge calls failed; superseded by the separate GPT rescore
runs.note: The saved 1.83% and 2.44% numbers are invalid and are not displayed as performance results. All 206 original report-checking calls failed. Do not count this campaign and its rescore as independent model attempts.

runs.name: Qwen3.8 baseline · earlier Qwen Code test
runs.note: Partial coverage only. A different action budget and execution setup prevent a harness-only comparison with OpenCode. Qwen Code is retained here as history, not used for new evaluations.

runs.name: Qwen3.8 · small repair checks
runs.scoring: OpenCode V6, V7 and V12 accepted; Qwen Code V7 accepted
runs.note: OpenCode V6 and V7 each completed one attempt; V12 completed four. Qwen Code V6 had an invalid judge reply. These tests establish that parts of the system work, not benchmark-wide performance.

runs.name: Qwen3.8 · incomplete wider reruns
runs.harness: OpenCode 1.18.27; historical Qwen Code controls in early runs
runs.note: Separate repair campaigns, not extra samples to pool. Problems included unavailable target images, model-provider failures, memory exhaustion, missing files and score-validation failures. Unknown counts are deliberately left blank.

config.Latest memory correction: One attempt at a time; explicit 48 GiB agent limit inside a 64 GiB sandbox

runs.name: Teacher-SFT checkpoint · first matched check
runs.collection: Both controllers exited; temporary machines released
runs.note: A process finishing is not enough to claim a usable result or improvement. The wider V30/V31 preparations do not establish completed evaluations.

runs.name: Fresh75 checkpoint · failed infrastructure launch
runs.collection: 0 usable; nine restored machines failed their startup check; six were never created
runs.scoring: Not started; no model attempts existed to score
runs.note: This is not a model result and is not a score of zero. Every launched machine failed before Qwen was called because the restored evaluation environment was not ready. The nine launched machines were released and Fresh75 serving was paused. A replacement must first pass one freshly restored environment and one saved rollout canary.
